seeds: seed_for('c-repl-<model>__<sampler>', 'bundle-<law>', b), b = 0..19 (torch CUDA generator, one per bundle); benchmark bundle: stage 'bench-I1', rep 0 (not used in results)
frozen_from_R2: per unit: config.yaml frozen h and start laws (pool set, overdispersion 3, box radius 2), kernel/Nystrom basis (setup.npz), operators O_t (sigma.npz), NUTS reference sets; the R2 code path (Context, StartLaws.sample, MHSampler.run)
readings: identical to Stage 2: prefix-group feature means minus the mean feature embedding of NUTS runs 0-7 of the evaluation set; spans S3 / S4own / S4same, m = 8 (4), margins none / halfsplit, R in {0.5, 1, 2, 4}, eps in {0.10, 0.05}
heldout: the Stage-2 held-out estimate (run main/c_v1, split 'heldout': saved-ensemble evaluation half, replicas 2048..4095, vs NUTS runs 8-15) at each t <= 4096; the bundles are new draws of the same chain law (same frozen sampler and start law), checked by a two-sample MMD^2 between all 1280 bundle chains and that evaluation half at every t (law-identity check)
comparisons: bundle-to-bundle variation (quantiles over 20 bundles) vs the Stage-2 saved-state groups (512 x 4, 128 x 16, 32 x 64) at the same t; crossings restricted to t <= 4096 for both
statuses: plug-ins: reference-based plug-in at an assumed radius (feature space); held-out: empirical estimate; no confidence statement beyond the Stage-1 floor table
conditioning: all bundles share the NUTS references (runs 0-7 / 8-15), the pool (start laws), the calibration run (features), the operators O_t, the frozen h and the R2 grid choice (horizon pilot used all 16 runs); bundles are independent of each other and of the saved ensembles only given these; this is an empirical practicality replication, not a 95% coverage study
